name: NIST SP 800-63B password minimum length
before: Verifiers SHALL require subscriber-chosen memorized secrets to be at least 8 characters in length.
after: SHALL require passwords that are used as a single-factor authentication mechanism to be a minimum of 15 characters in length.

name: WCAG 2.1 to 2.2 adds a separate minimum target-size criterion
before: Criterion 2.5.5 sets a 44-by-44 CSS pixel target size for pointer input, subject to exceptions.
after: Criterion 2.5.5 sets a 44-by-44 CSS pixel target size for pointer input, subject to exceptions.
Criterion 2.5.8 sets a 24-by-24 CSS pixel target size for pointer input, subject to exceptions.
